name: vLLM-TorchTPU installation
description: Install the PyTorch-native vLLM TPU plugin; distinct from the vllm-tpu JAX backend.

assertions.assertion: vLLM-TorchTPU installation provides official guidance on Install the PyTorch-native vLLM TPU plugin; distinct from the vllm-tpu JAX backend.
TorchTPU is the native PyTorch runtime replacing the deprecated PyTorch/XLA backend for TPU workloads.
vLLM-TorchTPU is the out-of-tree PyTorch-native serving backend for vLLM on TPUs, distinct from the JAX-native vllm-tpu backend.

qaPairs.question: What is vLLM-TorchTPU installation used for in Cloud TPU workflows?
qaPairs.answer: Install the PyTorch-native vLLM TPU plugin; distinct from the vllm-tpu JAX backend.
